newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Stream International announces 300 jobs in Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Stream International announces 300 jobs in Ireland.

text.p: Stream International, a U.S. manufacturer and supplier of software and corporate technology services, said on Thursday it will generate 300 new jobs in a 10 million punt investment in Ireland.

The company said 200 jobs will be created at the European Technology Centre it is developing at a new site on the Willsborough Industrial Estate in Dublin and a further 100 jobs will be created at its existing Kildare town facility.
Stream International said the investment in Kildare will enable the expansion of its current turnkey and fulfilment operations.

The company said its Technology Centre will use state-of-the-art technology to provide electronic software manufacturing, print on demand, ordering, distribution, technical consultancy services and licence management.
Stream said its opening would have far reaching consequences on how software and similar intellectual property is developed, stored, produced, managed and distributed.

"The European Technology Centre, based in Willsborough, will be able to supply its customers through whatever medium they require -- customised electronic print, CD, DVD, on-line information and electronic commerce," Paul Kavanagh, president of Stream's operations for Europe, said.
